summary: Initial SRanger controller generated (9 Java files, 3 modes, 7 specified transitions plus one Final self-loop). Four review items flagged.

issues.title: Final mode given a tick self-loop
issues.raw: SR-FR3 describes Final as terminal with no outgoing transition; the codegen rules require every mode to have an outgoing transition.
issues.fix_directive: Confirm that a tick-triggered Final->Final self-loop with no action is acceptable; it keeps Final terminal (never left) while giving it an enabled transition. It is an extra transition beyond SR-Beh1..7.

issues.title: Clock accessor named nowMs() but returns seconds
issues.raw: SR-Var1/SR-DM2 express clockResetTime and turnDuration in seconds; the extractor convention reads clocks through nowMs().
issues.fix_directive: Clock.nowMs() returns seconds so that turnDuration stays 2.0 and the model constant is not scaled to 2000. Review whether the name/unit mismatch is acceptable.

issues.title: Moving->Turning: obstacle event AND obstacleDetected guard
issues.raw: SR-Beh2 says the transition fires when the obstacle event is received; SR-GP1 says obstacleDetected is the guard on the same transition.
issues.fix_directive: Implemented as trigger obstacle with guard obstacleDetected (both requirements honoured). An obstacle event with distance above the threshold is ignored.

issues.title: Sensor no-reading default of 1000.0 m
issues.raw: SR-DM5 asks for a 'large default value' without a number.
issues.fix_directive: Sensor.NO_READING_DISTANCE = 1000.0 (private to Sensor, not a controller constant).

next_step: Run the pipeline (compile -> coverage -> preflight -> T2M -> M2M -> M2T -> verifiers).
